dialogues.text: Yes? What's on the menu today?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Today it's... Oh, it's you. I thought it was that old fogey. Seriously, what's his problem, shouting all the time at his age? My poor ears...

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Well, anyway. I've prepared some Sunsettia and Berry slices mixed in Sweet Flower juice, along with some minced Berries and Mints...
